extName.message: Windial – Window Switcher by Number Keys

extDesc.message: Window switcher for Chrome: press a shortcut, then a number. See every window by name and favicons, jump in two keystrokes.

searchPlaceholder.message: Search window names, tabs and URLs

footSearchEnter.message: Enter opens the window and that tab

moveStay.message: Hold Alt to move without following

renameHint.message: Enter saves · Esc cancels · empty name restores the default

optNamesHelp.message: Names are matched to windows by their tabs, so they survive a Chrome restart. Windows you have not named are called after the site of their first tab.

optNamesEmpty.message: No names saved yet. Press F2 in the list to name a window.

optShortcutHelp.message: Chrome may refuse a shortcut that is already taken. Pick another one in the Chrome shortcuts page.

optPrivacy.message: Windial keeps everything in this browser profile and never sends anything anywhere.

welcomeNone.message: Chrome did not assign a shortcut. The suggested key was probably already taken by Chrome or by another extension. Setting one takes ten seconds.

welcomeHow.message: On the page that opens, find Windial, click the pencil next to “Open the window list” and press the keys you want. Good choices: ⌥W, ⌘⇧C or ⌘⇧X on Mac; Alt+W or Ctrl+Shift+Y on Windows and Linux.

welcomeWatching.message: This page updates by itself once the shortcut is set.

keyOpen.message: Open the window list. Press it again to close.

keyDigits.message: Jump to that window. Numbers follow the order windows were opened and stay put.

keyZero.message: Last window, however many there are

keyEnter.message: Previous window (preselected when the list opens)

keyType.message: Search window names, tab groups, tab titles and URLs. Enter opens the window and the matching tab.

keyShift.message: Move the current tab into that window and follow it. Add Alt to stay.

popupNoShortcut.message: No shortcut is set — click to choose one

welcomeWaiting.message: Waiting for the list to open…

welcomeWorks.message: It works. You can close this tab.

welcomeNotOpening.message: Nothing happened? Chrome sometimes shows a shortcut without registering it. Open the shortcuts page and enter the combination again — the same one is fine.

moveAcrossIncognito.message: Tabs can’t move between normal and incognito windows

rateLink.message: Rate Windial on the Chrome Web Store
